claims.claim: November 2026 starts on Sunday and has 30 days; the Saturdays are 7, 14, 21, 28 and Sundays are 1, 8, 15, 22, 29.
There is no nationwide statutory public holiday in November 2026; the next public holiday is Christmas Day, Dec 25.
The 2027 academic-year CSAT is on Thursday, Nov 19, 2026.
Nov 7 is Ip-dong and Nov 22 is So-seol according to the 2026 calendar reference.

sources.title: 2026년 월력요항 발표
sources.body: Korea AeroSpace Administration release, 2025-06-30, establishes the official 2026 calendar criteria and public holidays. November dates calculated from Gregorian calendar; official release also confirms the year’s statutory holiday framework.

sources.title: 관공서의 공휴일에 관한 규정
sources.body: National Law Information Center. Statutory public holiday list; November has no fixed national holiday. Regional closures or one-off temporary holidays can differ if later designated.

sources.title: 2027학년도 대학수학능력시험 시행일 안내
sources.body: Ministry of Education official notice: the 2027 academic-year CSAT will be held Thursday, November 19, 2026; score reports are scheduled for December 11.

sources.title: 월력요항
sources.body: Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute calendar reference for official lunar dates, 24 solar terms, national holidays and commemorative days.

cannotSay: No claim about individual company, school, or local institution schedules; those can differ.
November has 9 Saturdays/Sundays combined, not necessarily 9 non-working days for every worker.
No unannounced election day, temporary holiday, or local event is included.
